The structure of Sr2Y8Au4 (reduced formula SrY4Au2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Au centers in tetrahedral environments with four Y neighbors at 2.8484 Å, while Y centers show eight geometric neighbors (four Au and four Sr) and Sr centers show ten neighbors (eight Y and two Sr). Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Au tetrahedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Y and Sr polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
